name: Florida Panthers (Go Cats Go)
commemorates: JetBlue's expanded, multi-year partnership with the NHL's Florida Panthers (Stanley Cup champions 2024 and 2025) and its South Florida roots; Broward County's largest airline.
description: After the Panthers' jersey. Fuselage: Panthers red all over above a white belly, with 'FLORIDA' in bold red capitals along the belly (the jersey's white stripe) and the team's leaping-cat logo underneath too. 'jetBlue' in white over the forward windows; just behind it a large gold panther outlined in navy prowls forward across the window line, its tail curling up over the wing. Near the front, the Panthers' simplified Florida flag (the jersey's shoulder patch); elsewhere a palm tree and hockey stick, the team's old secondary logo; the registration with a small US flag over the aft windows, 'AIRBUS A320' under them. Tail: navy and gold, carrying the Panthers' shield logo (a snarling panther's head) big across it, a red tip. Engines navy; wingtip fences navy. Named 'Go Cats Go' (it was 'Blue And Infinity And Beyond').

sources.title: JetBlue and the Florida Panthers Take South Florida Dedication to New Heights with New Aircraft Design (JetBlue via Business Wire, 2026-11-05)
sources.note: JetBlue's release: 'Go Cats Go', an A320, revealed that day at FLL; red body, the panther beside JetBlue's logo, the navy-and-gold shield on the tail, 'FLORIDA' in red on a white belly with the leaping cat, the simplified Florida flag near the front, a palm tree and hockey stick. Business Wire, its media files and news.jetblue.com all refused automated access (403 / a Cloudflare challenge), so the text was read in Finviz's verbatim reprint (next) and no press image could be measured.
